jobs.title: Partnerships Lead, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
OP Labs builds Optimism, a blockchain network that powers the next generation of financial infrastructure. Hundreds of companies, from the world's largest enterprises like Sony, Coinbase, Kraken, Uniswap, OKX, and Bitpanda to the most ambitious early-stage builders, use the OP stack to launch their own blockchains and bring their users onchain. Today, over 65% of Layer 2 activity on Ethereum runs through the OP stack.

We are a small team building at the speed of the ecosystem we support. The NYC office is our center of gravity, and we have a strong preference for people who can join us there on a hybrid schedule. We've raised $178M from a16z, Paradigm, and others. We have our work cut out for us and are looking for exceptional people to join us.


Role and Responsibilities
As the Strategic Accounts Lead, you will own a portfolio of Optimism’s most strategic partners. You will serve as the single-threaded owner for these relationships, accountable for execution, long-term value creation, and measurable strategic and commercial outcomes. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, and GTM teams, you will align partner needs with Optimism’s roadmap and drive partnership strategy through to delivery.



WHAT ARE THE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES?

 - Own a portfolio of accounts as the primary point of accountability for revenue, execution, and overall partner success. You hold the senior relationships, and escalations come to you.

 - Lead the full lifecycle of each account: onboarding, chain deployment, ongoing performance management, upsell, and renewal.

 - Run Optimism's account management framework, including Joint Business Plans, clearly defined KPIs, and a structured cross-company operating model (QBRs, recurring CEO-to-CEO touchpoints).

 - Act as a trusted advisor to partners building out a comprehensive blockchain ecosystem, leveraging Optimism's relationships and pre-existing deals.

 - Coordinate deeply across Product, Engineering, Legal, Data, and GTM to scope work, resolve blockers, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

 - Identify risk and opportunity signals early, including churn risk, underperforming initiatives, and expansion opportunities, and own the remediation plan.


WHAT SKILLS DO YOU BRING?

 - Experience owning enterprise accounts against a revenue number.

 - Comfort selling things that aren't finished. You'll be taking capabilities to customers ahead of general availability, and you'll need to do it while setting expectations we can actually meet.

 - Strong understanding of the blockchain and Web3 landscape, particularly L1s/L2s, infrastructure, and developer ecosystems, with enough technical fluency to work effectively with product and engineering teams.

 - Communication and influence with senior stakeholders inside and outside the company, including the ability to shape a partner's ecosystem-building efforts.

 - Proven ability to structure and manage complex commercial relationships and negotiations, including incentives, renewals, and performance-based agreements.

 - Strong operational discipline: running QBRs, developing Joint Business Plans, managing KPIs, and coordinating cross-functional work.

 - High ownership mindset, strong judgment, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Health, fully covered. OP Labs pays 100% of your health insurance premiums, with a range of medical, dental, and vision plans to choose from.

 - 401(k) with a 4% company match.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend, to spend on whatever keeps you healthy and energized.

 - $1,000 WFH setup stipend and $1,000 learning budget

 - Competitive compensation, including performance bonus and token grants — you share in the growth of what we're building together.

 - Flexible time off. No fixed allotment. Take what you need.

 - 14 paid holidays, plus two Collective Pause weeks each year — the first week of July and the week between Christmas and New Year, when the whole company steps back at once.

 - Four-week sabbatical after three years, three of them paid, with your equity and tokens vesting throughout.

 - New York hybrid, or location-flexible (team dependent). Commercial and growth teams work from our SoHo office three days a week; engineering and technical roles are location-flexible.

 - We get together in person. Every team carries a travel budget so remote teammates can join us in New York, and we bring the whole company together at offsites twice a year.

 


We are aware of fraudulent individuals falsely claiming to represent OP Labs in recruitment activities.
Please note:

 - All official communication will come from an @oplabs.co http://oplabs.co email address, or from a verified LinkedIn profile.

 - We will never ask for payment, banking information, or personal identification details at any stage of our hiring process.

 - All current openings are listed exclusively on our official careers page https://www.optimism.io/careers and linked from our verified social profiles.

 - If you’re ever unsure about a communication that claims to be from OP Labs, please contact us directly at people@oplabs.co to verify authenticity.

Your safety and trust are very important to us. Thank you for helping us prevent fraud.

jobs.description:

We've raised $178M from a16z, Paradigm, and others. We have our work cut out for us and are looking for exceptional people to join us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Lead to own the business analytics and reporting that inform OP Labs' commercial and strategic decisions. This senior individual contributor role sits within Data & Strategy and combines business judgment, crypto knowledge, and clear communication to explain performance and recommend action.

You will partner closely with leadership, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Finance to analyze revenue, customer activity, pipeline, and ecosystem trends. You will independently identify and scope business questions, combine onchain data with commercial data and market research, and turn findings into business cases, recurring reports, and recommendations with measurable follow-through.



WHAT ARE THE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES?

 - Own recurring business reporting: define and maintain metrics, dashboards, and business reviews that explain changes in revenue, customer activity, commercial pipeline, and ecosystem position.

 - Partner with leadership, Business Development, Product, and Finance to identify and prioritize business questions, scope the analysis, and translate findings into decisions.

 - Own analytical SQL, metric definitions, and data validation. Reconcile commercial and onchain sources, document discrepancies, and partner with engineering on production data infrastructure.

 - Analyze customer segments, pipeline conversion, revenue concentration, retention, and performance drivers across OP Enterprise, OP Mainnet, and the Superchain. Test competing explanations and make uncertainty explicit.

 - Produce concise memos, presentations, and dashboards that state the finding, supporting evidence, business implications, and recommended action.

 - Evaluate crypto market and competitive developments, including adoption, liquidity, stablecoin activity, and fees, in the context of customer needs and business economics.

 - Build pricing analyses, revenue scenarios, market assessments, and partnership business cases with explicit assumptions and sensitivities; track results after decisions are made.

 - Improve repeatable reporting and research workflows using SQL, BI tools, and AI-assisted analysis while remaining accountable for accuracy and source traceability.


WHAT SKILLS DO YOU BRING?

 - 6+ years of experience in business analytics, business intelligence, strategy, management consulting, strategic finance, or a related analytical role.

 - A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. Management consulting experience, an MBA, or deep crypto industry knowledge are equally valued.

 - Strong commercial judgment and experience building financial models and business cases that informed pricing, customer prioritization, partnerships, or resource allocation.

 - Experience owning recurring reporting and analytical work across business functions, including agreeing metric definitions, reconciling sources, and resolving conflicting interpretations.

 - Strong SQL, spreadsheet modeling, and data visualization skills, with the ability to inspect underlying data and validate results independently. Python for analysis and automation is a plus.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise executive recommendations, clear explanations of uncertainty, and constructive challenge with senior stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated crypto knowledge is required: working understanding of Ethereum, L2s, stablecoins, DeFi, and crypto business models, with the ability to explain what onchain metrics do and do not establish.

 - Ability to independently identify and scope ambiguous business questions, prioritize work, manage stakeholders, and follow recommendations through to measurable results.

 - Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis and reporting while checking source data, calculations, and conclusions.
